title: Built outside the day job.
sub: Side projects, open-source engines, and major backend architectures I've built and deployed.

projects.title: Astrarium
projects.tagline: A real-time, to-scale solar system orrery & orbital simulation engine.
bullets: To-scale 3D model of the solar system — every planet, dwarf planet, and major moon, positioned from real astronomical Keplerian data.
Keplerian orbital-motion engine with true-to-scale velocity, live orbit tracking, and a custom clock scaling from real time to years per second.
Published an npm package for high-precision line rendering, using camera-relative coordinates to eliminate GPU floating-point jitter at astronomical scales.
Three custom camera systems, including a six-axis free-flight mode built from scratch to handle extreme time-scale chase scenes.

projects.title: Context Studio
projects.tagline: An AI knowledge and content workspace for adaptive research briefs.
bullets: A fault-tolerant, idempotent document-ingestion pipeline for a serverless environment, with database-based locking and lock-expiry queues.
A hybrid retrieval system that routes between lexical and vector search based on query length, interleaving results where both work.
A feedback-driven research-brief system with adaptive topic and source weighting, refining future briefs on a cron-based schedule.

projects.title: Nym4Business Platform
projects.tagline: Multi-tenant B2B fintech infrastructure for SMEs and enterprise payments.
bullets: End-to-end feature delivery for a multi-tenant platform giving SMEs and organizations access to financial infrastructure.
Configurable approval-rule engine with custom transaction conditions (amount, type, sender/recipient) and multi-approver workflows.
Two-factor authentication, audit logging, and role-based dashboards integrated with NymCard's core payment systems.

projects.title: BorrowBe Marketplace
projects.tagline: Peer-to-peer rental marketplace with real-time geolocation and wallet.
bullets: Hybrid geolocation and address-based search system with map, radius, and structured address queries.
Real-time chat and notification system with per-listing conversation identity and live presence.
Stripe-integrated wallet with a hybrid ledger (direct payments and credits) and hash-locked transaction immutability.

projects.title: Korn Ferry Talent Suite Backend
projects.tagline: Enterprise HR-tech platform backend serving 150+ countries.
bullets: Core backend microservices powering a global platform serving thousands of organizations across 150+ countries.
Designed an internal-routing system reducing inter-service latency by 70% and overall latency by 40%.
Streaming export system for multi-gigabyte audit logs and zero-overhead request-tracing system.
